fullDesc: In August 2018 15-year-old Greta Thunberg began skipping school to sit outside the Swedish parliament demanding action on climate change. Her Fridays for Future protests spread to millions of students worldwide.
realFacts: She sailed across the Atlantic in 2019 to avoid flying
She spoke at the UN in 2019
Time named her Person of the Year in 2019
She has Asperger's and calls it her superpower
